research_contract.question: How can a service model reflect delivered value while sustainably funding operation, support and continued improvement?
source_scopes: Owner-approved, redacted cost and delivery evidence
research_contract.decision_to_change: Compare build fees, recurring operation and value-linked pricing from authorized delivery and cost evidence.
success_criteria: Separate attributable customer value, implementation cost, ongoing support and commercial risk.
Compare realistic alternatives and label untested willingness-to-pay assumptions.
falsifiers: A pricing claim depends on value that cannot be attributed to the delivered service.
Support, operating cost or risk erases the model's claimed sustainability under plausible conditions.
evidence_gaps: No public result here establishes a unique market category, agreed client price or willingness to pay.
watch_triggers: New owner-approved outcome or counterexample changes the decision evidence.
